help:
Bot Usage Guide:

Supported Platforms:
1. YouTube (Videos, Shorts & YouTube Music)
2. Instagram (Posts, Reels & Stories)
3. X / Twitter (Video & Image tweets)
4. TikTok (No-watermark videos)
5. Pinterest (Original videos & photos)
6. Threads (Videos & Photos)
7. Reddit (Videos with audio & Images)

Simply send any media link in the chat to download.
